newsitem.title: USA: Three-Five secures LCD module order.
newsitem.headline: Three-Five secures LCD module order.

text.p: Three-Five Systems Inc said Monday it has received a significant production order for a liquid crystal display module from a major U.S.-based manufacturer of telecommunications equipment.

Three-Five said in a statement it plans to begin volume production in the third quarter of 1997, and expects measurable revenue during that quarter. The company declined to specify how much revenue it expected.

The production order calls for a module containing a liquid crystal display, printed circuit board driver and related components that will be used in a digital cellular telephone application for distribution in the U.S.
